summary: Fifth attempt at the startup committed-log replay experiment, fixing the test selection: test_names now lists only the exact top-level name TestAssuranceRestoreMidbandReplay, with the three subtest-qualified entries removed; the harness still runs all three cases as subtests and emits mb_case_/mb_result_ events for midband_replay, capacity_replay and over_capacity_replay. The rest of the request is unchanged from the version the controller accepted through its earlier checks: requirement is null and anchors empty, so no requirement-basis check applies; all reused source IDs match their stored excerpts exactly; and the only new ID, store_commit_interface, covers the complete CommitTrackingLogStore declaration at log.go 194-221. Local verification of the harness stands: on real single-node prefixes that commit 200 commands, snapshot at index 202 and commit a second batch, a 50-batch tail (3198 entries) returns in 1 ms, exactly 128 batches (8192 entries, the channel capacity) returns in 3 ms, and 129 batches (8194 entries) does not return within 20 s with one goroutine parked in processLogs. The request pairs the three case events as prerequisites with their action on three result events asserting returned == true, and validates against submission.schema.json.
